archetype.why: the archetypes the training failures happen to share

discounting.why: heavy discounting makes the value of a plan depend on precise timing, and a surrogate asked only for the ORDER has the least to give there

archetype-only.why: the orebody shapes the training failures land on, with no scenario condition

dominant-archetype.why: the single orebody shape with the highest failure rate on the training deposits

aggressive-scenario.why: the single most aggressive scenario in the sweep

shipped_caveat: chosen after the holdout refuted the archetype rule, so its held-out precision and recall are optimistic; the direction of the choice is recall, not precision
refuted: core_halo: 80/108 of training cases fail, 36/54 held out; layered: 0/108 of training cases fail, 0/54 held out; porphyry: 2/108 of training cases fail, 0/54 held out; vein: 6/108 of training cases fail, 3/54 held out. The failures concentrate in core_halo, and they do so on BOTH splits, which is what the first and much narrower sweep could not show: with five scenarios running rate and capacity together at a correlation of -0.735, the scenario looked like the cause and the orebody looked refuted.
